capabilities: Insert entries, items, monsters, and tables
Playtest the book in a side pane
Flag broken choices and unreachable sections
Report on fight difficulty and paths
Export for print, ebook, and gamebook.press
disambiguation: Not only a gamebook.press publishing tool; it is a full local authoring and playtesting environment.
extras: Closed source but released under the MIT License; makes no network requests and has no telemetry. Writing, playing, and exporting need no account; only publishing on gamebook.press does. Supports Dungeon Crawl Classics, d20 Classic, and Standard Gamebook monster formats.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author, playtest, and export branching gamebooks with dice, fights, items, and character sheets.
